name: erp-raizes
description: ERP Raízes da Bahia - gestão de vendas de tapioca

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c auto "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:prod: concurrently -k -n api,web -c auto "npm run dev:prod -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.setup: npm run migrate -w server && npm run seed -w server
